title: Tanbeeh: Revolutionizing Safety and Efficiency with AI
summary: DP World reports that facial recognition in its Tanbeeh platform cut truck entry at the gate from three minutes to 15 seconds; prevented injuries are unproven.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: DP World states that Tanbeeh went live on 1 November 2023. On 5 November 2024, DP World received the UAE AI Award in the Operational Efficiency category for Tanbeeh. The National's report of the award says that the platform helps detect fires within five seconds, and it gives no gate figures. In its project account, current as of June 2025, DP World reports that Tanbeeh reduced gate entry from three minutes to 15 seconds. The platform also monitors fire and protective equipment, but prevented injuries are unproven. For protective equipment, the report alternates between detection accuracy and compliance. The report also gives inconsistent fire-detection times. No independent source reports gate times.
purpose: Automate industrial access control and safety monitoring.
location: DP World industrial facilities; particular site unspecified
